verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm a live llms.txt at obsessiondb.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs mirror at /docs.md. Markdown doc pages such as feature-status.md and ingesting-data.md are also served, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and any first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown docs as an agent-facing feature.
